name: Amagi Ren'ichi
source:
School: 2nd-year student, Moriyoh Gakuen
As the main 'hero' of the game, he's the 2nd year student of Moriyoh, and the typical popular, handsome guy. All of the girls have some interest in him. He joined to look forward to a fun, casual relationship.
